Overview

Hillerød is a city in Capital Region with a population of 35,000. A town in North Zealand, home to the magnificent Frederiksborg Castle and surrounded by forests and lakes. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
